d:
Maujuda vitt varsh (2025-26) ke bajat men bihar sarkar ne shiksha ke lie sabse zyada yani 21.7 pratishat (karib 61 hazar karor rupae) ka pravdhan kiya hai. lekin kya itne bare nivesh se zamini halat badal pae hain? kya bachchon ki parhaee-likhaee ki gunvatta behtar huee hai? kya sarkari skulon ke inphrastrakchar, shikshakon ki uplabdhata aur natijon men vakaee sudhar ho raha hai, ya phir aankron aur ghoshnaon ke pichhe ab bhi vahi purani chunautiyan chhipi hain. dekhie, shikshan sansthaon ki asliyat bayan karti bibisi sanvaddata abhinav goyal ki ye graund riport.
